items.description: Adds the `set`, `get`, `has`, and `delete` subcommands to `thor-secret`, which act on a keychain secret named by a service and an optional `--account`, and exit 1 when the secret is not stored, 2 on a usage error, and 3 when the keychain cannot be reached, as `tb-secret` does. (#530)

Adds the `@williamthorsen/secret-tools` package with a `thor-secret` binary, which prints its help for `--help`, `-h`, or no arguments and exits with code 2 on any other argument, to hold the `tb-secret` port in #518. (#525)
